laws.rule: At Pamukkale (Hierapolis) the Ministry of Culture and Tourism limits visitors to the main paths around the travertine terraces, and asks people to take their shoes off to stand on the calcium deposits. The ministry page does not give a penalty. The Denizli culture and tourism directorate describes walking on the main travertine areas as prohibited because new travertine crumbles, and names a man-made pool area and a travertine area near the South Gate that are open for contact with the water.
